taskDescription: Complete the crossword using key terms from PA G4 | Neoplasia.

words.clue: Abnormal mass of tissue with autonomous, uncoordinated growth that persists after the initiating stimulus ceases
Component of every neoplasm consisting of the proliferating neoplastic cells that determine the tumor's name and behavior
Supporting tissue of blood vessels and fibroblasts that tumors induce the host to provide
Stromal reaction producing abundant collagen deposition, giving rise to the hard scirrhous consistency of some carcinomas
Process by which tumors induce formation of new blood vessels, essential for growth beyond 1-2 millimeters
Malignant neoplasm arising from cells of epithelial origin
Malignant neoplasm arising from cells of mesenchymal tissue origin
Benign neoplasm arising from glandular epithelium
Malignant neoplasm of haematopoietic cell origin that misleadingly carries the benign-sounding -oma suffix
Highly aggressive malignant neoplasm of melanocytes that metastasizes early despite its -oma suffix
Benign tumor arising from squamous or transitional epithelium with surface projections
